```plato
//==
// # TRS transforms
//
// Translate-rotate-scale transforms in 2D and 3D: the authoring-friendly
// representation whose three parts are edited independently. They are NOT closed
// under composition — rotating a non-uniform scale leaves the TRS family — so
// compose them through their matrix or affine forms
//. The operations live in
// `transforms.library.plato`.

// A translate-rotate-scale transform in 2D, applied scale first, then rotation,
// then translation.
type TrsTransform2D
    implements IValue, IAffine2D
{
    Translation: Vector2D;
    Rotation: Rotation2D;
    Scale: Number2;
}
```
